entities.summary: John Randolph Thune is an American politician from South Dakota who has served in the United States Senate since 2005. A Republican, Thune previously served as U.S. representative for South Dakota's at-large congressional district. He has been the Senate majority leader and Senate Republican leader since January 2025.
